big_case.notes: Individual pro se emergency stay-of-removal application arising from a routine, unpublished Third Circuit immigration decision with no broader constitutional, statutory, or policy impact beyond the applicants.

leakage.notes: Forward prediction created 2026-10-31T18:04:49Z before the event resolved on 2026-11-02. The candidate retrieved the underlying Third Circuit opinion (No. 25-2933, filed 2026-07-08) via CourtListener MCP and queried SCOTUS/CA3 corpus priors. One CourtListener docket query and one corpus query checked SCOTUS 26A606 on 2026-10-31 while the application was still genuinely open and undecided.

central_claims.basis: The docket entry of Nov 2, 2026 records 'Application (26A606) denied by Justice Alito' (five days after the Oct 28 docketing date and seventeen days after the Oct 16 submission), with no separate writing or noted dissent in outcome.json.
central_claims.claim: The application will be denied by Justice Alito in a single-sentence order without noted dissent or separate writing within roughly one to two weeks of docketing.

central_claims.basis: outcome.json records interim_signals.response_requested = false and the Nov 3, 2026 docket snapshot shows no response request prior to denial.
central_claims.claim: Justice Alito will not call for a response from the Solicitor General (response-requested-increment: 0.03).

central_claims.basis: outcome.json records interim_signals.referred_to_court = false and the Nov 2, 2026 docket entry states the application was denied by Justice Alito alone.
central_claims.claim: Justice Alito will act on the application in chambers as Circuit Justice without referring it to the full Court (referral-increment: 0.02).

central_claims.basis: outcome.json records interim_signals.amicus_briefs = 0 and no amicus entries appear on the Nov 3, 2026 docket snapshot.
central_claims.claim: No amicus curiae submissions or filings will occur before disposition (amicus-increment: 0.005).
